name: oh-my-dynamic
description: Multi-agent orchestration engine with DAG execution, stop conditions, TEA protocol, and hierarchical synthesis. Replicates Claude Dynamic Workflows for any LLM.

interface.shortDescription: Multi-agent dynamic workflow orchestration for Codex.
interface.longDescription: oh-my-Dynamic decomposes complex tasks into DAG-structured subtasks, runs multi-agent workers, dynamically replans, and synthesizes results.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use oh-my-Dynamic to decompose this task, run multi-agent analysis, and synthesize the result.
